title: Government Affairs Manager
teaser: Join our team as a Government Affairs Manager to represent Cisco with leaders across the Benelux region, advancing public policy and engaging in key legislative and regulatory matters. This role suits an experienced professional with a strong background in government affairs and public policy, fluent in English and Dutch.
description:
Meet the Team

Cisco is seeking a government affairs and public policy professional to join its global Government Affairs team as Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg (Benelux) Government Affairs Manager. Based in the Netherlands and reporting to the Vice President of Government Affairs for Europe, this individual will help lead Cisco’s government engagements and public policy efforts throughout the region. 

Cisco’s Government Affairs team represents the company with governments around the world to build relationships with key leaders, advance Cisco’s public policy goals, and educate governments about our industry. Government Affairs is involved in all key legislative, regulatory, and global issues that impact the technology industry.

We are comprised of government and public policy experts across two dozen countries who represent Cisco at the highest levels of government. The team has extensive experience in and out of government and are recognized leaders in the industry.       

Your Impact

 

As Benelux Government Affairs Manager, you will represent Cisco with leaders at all levels of government to facilitate our engagement throughout the region. You will play a pivotal role in formulating and implementing innovative policy solutions that advance Cisco’s business and enable our purpose to power an inclusive future for all.

           

Key responsibilities include:

Cultivate strong relationships with key government leaders, elected officials, and policymakers to effectively convey Cisco’s perspective and strategic priorities

Proactively engage Cisco in local policymaking and regulatory processes, including representing the company in industry coalitions, government hearings, and other relevant meetings

Develop and execute advocacy strategies to help advance Cisco’s core public policy initiatives

Support Cisco’s public sector sales and business development teams with political, policy, and purpose-driven initiatives

Monitor and analyze political and policy trends across the region to advise on potential business implications

Prepare and present position papers, regulatory filings, testimony, and briefings

Work closely with Cisco’s leadership across the region and other senior executives globally, providing clear and concise explanations of complex regulatory and policy matters

Foster cross-border collaboration and knowledge sharing with Government Affairs colleagues in Europe and globally

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of political and public policy experience from roles within government, corporate government affairs, trade associations, law firms, and/or public policy institutions

Comprehensive understanding of the political and regulatory landscapes in the region, including the legislative and administrative processes involved in technology policy

Familiarity with public policy issues impacting the technology industry locally and globally

Near-native fluency in English and Dutch

Preferred Qualifications:

Telecommunications and technology-related experience in the private and public sectors

Exceedingly strong political judgement and relationship-building skills

Excellent communication, collaboration, and advocacy skills

Degree in political science, business, law, economics, or a similar field

This role requires ability to travel throughout the region and, on occasion, more widely.  And if you have German and/or French language skills too, that would be a good bonus.

Why Cisco

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Simply put – we power the future.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
